decisions.detail: settle() compared only expiry DATE against today, so contracts expiring today were resolved while the market was still open and hours from expiry. It booked P&L that did not exist (a fabricated $316 across 6 'settled' positions, several of them DEV orders miscounted against COMP because open_spreads() did not filter the journal by profile). Both bugs are fixed: same-day expiries now additionally require the market to be closed, and open_spreads()/report() are profile-scoped. These records are removed rather than kept because they were never valid observations of anything.
